title: Participatory Moral AI Is Not Neutral: The Invisible Hand of Developers

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing human participants' moral preferences and feature evaluations for hypothetical AI systems across conservative, moderate, and progressive political ideologies using moderated mediation models.
Measuring how different question formulations (Control, World-You-Want, Could-Be-You) alter participants' moral judgments and shift ideological gaps in AI preference elicitation tasks.
